image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on green vegetation. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is uniformly dark brown with faint, small eyespots (ocelli) visible near the wing margins. The body is slender, hairy, and brown. One antenna is clearly visible and appears clubbed. Several legs are visible gripping the plant stem.
